jobs.name: m2c-test
steps: Install ripgrep and bubblewrap (the tests that use the real tools skip without them)
Probe whether bubblewrap can start on this runner
Install the protocol schema libraries (jsonschema), pinned from protocol/requirements.txt

jobs.name: protocol
steps: Client copy of the schemas exists and is current

jobs.name: canary
steps: Install the m2c client without its dependencies (its rich and prompt_toolkit pins cannot be resolved with the backend's)
pip check (only m2c's own rich and prompt_toolkit lines are expected)
Scratch database (roles, auth stub, every migration in order)

jobs.name: promptfoo
steps: Install backend Python deps (role_provider.py imports eo/agents/utils)
Ensure promptfoo's configured env file exists (empty -- CI exports vars directly below)

backend/pyproject.toml.raw_head:
[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py311"

[tool.ruff.lint]
# Pinned per ci.yml's own header comment. A prior change (see git
# history / PR discussion for "B3") briefly moved this repo onto
# ruff's zero-config default rule set, which as of ruff 0.16 enables
# nearly every rule family (813 findings on this repo vs. 13 under
# this pinned selection, measured 2026-08-25 on ruff 0.16.4) -- but
# the two cleanup batches that change's own comment described (an
# auto-fix pass, then a manual-triage pass for RUF013/BLE001-style
# judgment calls) were never landed, so CI was red on every push
# regardless of what else changed. Reverted to the pinned selection to
# unblock CI now; broadening this again should ship together with the
# actual cleanup, not ahead of it.
select = ["E4", "E7", "E9", "F"]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
# This module borrows the `store` fixture from test_eo_code_proposals_deploy
# (imported, not moved), so every test taking `store` as an argument looks
# like a redefinition of an unused import to F811. That is how pytest
# fixture injection works, not a real shadowing bug.
"tests/unit/test_eo_code_proposals_wireframe.py" = ["F811"]

m2c/pyproject.toml.raw_head:
# m2c/pyproject.toml -- Patch C01: packaging for the M2C client.
#
# Build backend: hatchling. Chosen over setuptools because this is a pure-
# Python src-layout package with no compiled code and no setup.py quirks:
# PEP 517/660 editable installs work out of the box (`pip install -e .`),
# the version is read from one line in src/m2c/__init__.py without importing
# it, and `uv tool install` / `pipx` build it the same way. Pinned exactly,
# like the other tools in this repo (ruff, the CI actions): bump it
# deliberately, and prefer a release at least a couple of weeks old.
[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling==1.32.4"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[project]
name = "m2c"
dynamic = ["version"]
description = "M2C (Minime to Code): a local-first coding agent client for Linux and WSL2."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.11"            # decision D1
# Runtime dependencies: the standard library only, plus THREE exceptions.
# tests/test_cli.py fails if another is added here (or imported) without that
# test being changed on purpose.  The exception (Patch C04): ``websockets``, the
# WebSocket client of the device link (m2c/link), pinned exactly like
# daemon/requirements.txt so the two packages cannot drift; only m2c/link may
# import it.  Patch C09 adds ``prompt_toolkit`` and ``rich``, the terminal chat
# (decision D2); only m2c/tui/app.py imports them, and cli.py imports that
# module lazily, so headless mode and every other command never l
